Jak se dnes měnila připravenost od probu: How your readiness changed today from waking until now. In the morning it is set by overnight HRV, resting heart rate and sleep. During the day it is lowered by training according to how demanding it was and by the day outside training: movement above your usual day (by at most 8 points) and minutes of raised resting heart rate. The rows under the curve show what you were doing: training, movement, raised resting heart rate, rest and sleep, in 15-minute steps from all-day heart rate and steps. Your usual day is the median of your previous 28 days; it counts from 7 days of data. Tomorrow morning the overnight data replace all of this.
